faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHS Arunachal Pradesh Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Medical Officer posts is 23rd September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Medical Officer post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000 per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from an institution recognized by the National Medical Commission. A valid registration with the State Medical Council or the National Medical Commission is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Medical Officer position by the Directorate of Health Services Arunachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DHS Arunachal Pradesh Medical Officer recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official website to fill out and submit their applications.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: No, as per the notification, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General, OBC, SC, ST) applying for the Medical Officer posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based on a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates are advised to be prepared for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Medical Officer recruitment is scheduled to be held on 6th October 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend the interview on the specified date.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The official notification mentions the walk-in interview date, but the exact venue is not specified in the provided data. Candidates should refer to the official notification PDF for venue details.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The Medical Officer positions are being filled on a contractual basis. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the contract.
